name: One-time and Annual Financial Grant to Soldiers Awarded with Gallantry Medals
benefit: - A one time grant of maximum of ₹50,00,000/- and minimum ₹4,00,000/- is given. - Annual financial assistance of a maximum of ₹3,00,000/- and a minimum of ₹40,000/- is given.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant should be a serving soldier, an ex-serviceman, or in the event of martyrdom/death of the soldier, an eligible dependent. 1. The soldier must have been conferred with a “Gallantry Medal Award.” 1. In case of martyrdom or death of the soldier, the following dependents are eligible to apply: - Veer Nari (lifelong or until remarriage) - Son (up to 25 years of age) / Daughter (till marriage) - Parents - Unmarried sisters - Brother (up to 25 years of age)
